model: AcuRev 2100 multi-circuit meter with WEB2 module (BACnet IP)
applies_to: Accuenergy AcuRev 2100 multi-circuit meters (up to 18 input channels) with the WEB2 communication module.
summary: The AcuRev 2100 with the WEB2 module serves 1,230 read-only Analog Inputs: system and per-phase values, per-channel current, power, PF and load nature for input channels 1-18, energy, demand, peak demand, power quality, digital input values and individual harmonics. There are no binary objects.
notes: Input channel objects (channels 1-18) only report values for channels present on the installed hardware.
Instances run 1-1430 with gaps between sections.
Object_Name, Description and COV_Increment are writable and stored; the default COV increment is 0.
Source: Accuenergy 'BACnet Points List AcuRev2100-WEB2' spreadsheet, firmware v1.22, generated 2026-10-06.

integration.summary: All values are read-only. Map system power, energy, demand and PF, then per-channel power and energy for the tenant or load circuits.
gotchas: Objects exist for all 18 input channels; only channels on the installed hardware report values.
Object names are writable, so a site may have renamed them; map by instance.
